title: Adaptive representation-coordinate comparison
question: Can a physically transformed retention representation reduce support count at the same constitutive error limits more effectively than increasing interpolation order?
candidates: linear interpolation of logit(Se), with theta reconstructed from theta_r + (theta_s-theta_r)*Se
decision_rule: Prefer transformed retention only if every material satisfies all three error limits and support count is reduced without crossing a constitutive branch or changing authoritative physics.
